verdict.rationale: PostHog's own product analytics docs list "paths" as a first-class insight type alongside funnels and retention, built on the events users already send. That maps directly to exploring the routes users take. But the evidence is a single list mention with no detail on how path exploration works. missing for 10: documentation of anchoring paths before or after a specific key event, path filtering and visualization depth, independent or hands-on corroboration of the paths insight.
